title: A federated learning system, method, computer equipment and storage medium
assignee: State Grid Fujian Electric Power Co Ltd

pse.problem: Strong dependence on the central server and poor anti-risk capability of traditional federated learning methods.
pse.solution_function: A decentralized federated learning system that protects data privacy of edge terminal devices while improving its anti-risk capability. The system performs parameter training on the received initial fully connected network at the edge server based on feature vectors obtained from private data sets at edge terminal devices.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of multiple edge servers and multiple edge terminal devices. Each edge server is connected to at least one edge terminal device. The edge servers each have two identical initial global models, a pre-trained feature extraction network, and an initial fully connected network.
pse.solution_implementation: Edge terminal devices input their private data sets into the pre-trained feature extraction network to obtain feature vectors. Edge servers perform parameter training on the received initial fully connected network based on the feature vectors to create edge training models. The aggregation node collects and aggregates these edge training models to create an aggregated global model, which is then updated and sent back to the edge servers if it does not converge.
pse.effect: Improved decentralization, data privacy protection, and anti-risk capability compared to traditional federated learning methods
